name: Click Indicator
description: Shows a macro's clicks as osu!mania-style bars in the level and a rhythm lane.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole mod on or off.

menu-key.name: Menu Hotkey
menu-key.description: Key that opens the Click Indicator menu from anywhere, even mid-level (the level pauses). You can also use the button in the pause menu.

macro-folder.name: Macro Folder
macro-folder.description: Put macro files here. A file is used automatically when its name matches the <cy>level ID</c> or <cy>level name</c> (for example <cg>12345.gdr</c> or <cg>Bloodbath.gdr.json</c>).

macro-file.name: Fallback Macro File
macro-file.description: Used when no file in the macro folder matches the level. Supports <cg>.gdr</c>, <cg>.gdr.json</c>, <cg>.gdr2</c> and JSON macros.

offset-ms.name: Timing Offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: Shifts every click earlier (negative) or later (positive) if the bars look slightly off.

show-bars.name: Show Click Bars
show-bars.description: Green bars in the level where each click happens. Thin line = tap, wide bar = hold.

show-hit-line.name: Show Hit Line
show-hit-line.description: The vertical line that follows the player.

show-markers.name: Show Click Markers
show-markers.description: Small squares on each bar at the player's height.

hide-passed.name: Hide Passed Clicks
hide-passed.description: Only draw clicks that are still ahead of the player.

show-lane.name: Show Rhythm Lane
show-lane.description: The osu!mania-style lane on the side of the screen.

lane-speed.name: Lane Scroll Speed
lane-speed.description: How fast notes fall in the lane (pixels per second).

show-judgments.name: Show Timing Judgments
show-judgments.description: Compares your clicks to the macro and shows PERFECT / GREAT / GOOD / MISS with the offset in milliseconds.
